purpose: Increase effective research/tool throughput while lowering repeated source/plugin discovery, duplicate reads, context load, and cross-unit contention without widening authority.

policy: Build a small dependency graph for the task before broad retrieval.
Run all independent read-only evidence nodes concurrently when the active execution surface supports concurrency.
Batch multiple independent lookups into one connector/tool invocation when its API supports batching.
Do not serialize independent providers merely because they belong to one unit.
Serialize or lease consequential shared-state writes and one-shot scarce resources.
Cancel or suppress lower-value retrieval once the evidence threshold for the decision is already satisfied.
Do not pre-load every plugin or source at startup; discover/load only the minimum capability set needed for the current task.
execution_model.parallelism_claim_boundary: Repository rules can maximize logical/effective parallelism but cannot override hard concurrency limits imposed by ChatGPT, a connector, provider, quota, or external service.

startup_fast_path.goal: Do not make each restart pay the cost of loading every source/equipment surface.
mandatory_first_reads: exact active Gate/PR/artifact only when relevant
deferred_until_needed: large historical ledgers not relevant to current task

source_priority.name: DISCOVERY_COMMUNITY
source_priority.use: hypothesis generation and demand/sentiment signals; never sole authority for consequential claims

classes.STABLE: reuse compact receipt when still within task-relevant freshness window
classes.VOLATILE: Fresh-read for each decision/report where material
classes.CONSEQUENTIAL_SHARED_STATE: always Fresh-read immediately before action and after action

evidence_budget.principle: Use the cheapest sufficient evidence set, not the largest possible source set.
default_stop_conditions: material conflict either resolved or explicitly surfaced
additional sources are unlikely to change the decision

default_core: native web/search when current external facts are needed
軍師.strategy: route and synthesize; avoid reading every lane/source when a compact canonical pointer is sufficient

default_core: Context7 when library/API behavior is material
システム改善.strategy: code/config evidence first; exact failing path before broad platform research

on_demand: provider-specific tools only when connected and separately authorized
AI研究.strategy: parallel provider/evidence lanes; preserve provider neutrality and independent challenge

百人将.strategy: parallelize market/demand/competition evidence; live publication/payment/outreach remains separately gated

default_core: authoritative official data/source tools permitted by current research scope
on_demand: web/search for permitted public methodology/source verification
特殊部隊.strategy: protected scientific boundaries override speed; no parallel access that widens sealed/result/economics scope

対話室.strategy: idea generation should not pay for broad evidence retrieval until an idea reaches review/promotion need

本城.strategy: architecture/code path first; deployment/live mutation separately gated

on_demand: Stripe for payment-system facts when relevant and non-live
法務.strategy: authoritative-primary first; avoid broad commentary when official source answers the question

cross_unit_shared_read_bus.meaning: Units may reuse compact fresh read receipts/canonical pointers produced by another unit when exact source/version/freshness requirements match.

definition_of_done: Unit startup no longer performs broad all-plugin/all-source loading by default.
Independent evidence reads are expressed as parallelizable DAG nodes rather than serial prose-driven retrieval.
Duplicate identical source reads are coalesced/reused when freshness permits.
Consequential writes remain collision-safe and fresh-bound.
Each unit has a small default-core equipment set plus on-demand equipment.
Owner is not required to coordinate source/tool reuse between units.
The fabric itself does not become a new authority layer or require per-unit duplicate frameworks.
